name: ocr97_night_5_academic_twocolumn
description: Night 5: Two-column academic papers and technical algorithm specifications. Directly stresses Surya column detection, phase2 ensemble on diagrams/figures, and extraction of structured benchmark tables with precise numeric cells. arXiv papers use LaTeX-rendered two-column layout with sub-figures, attention diagrams, and performance matrices.

documents.title: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017) — arXiv:1706.03762
documents.license_note: arXiv open access preprint. Non-commercial use.
documents.goal: Extract a two-column academic machine learning paper with BLEU score benchmark tables, training configuration tables, and equation-heavy prose describing the attention mechanism and multi-head self-attention architecture. Tests column detection and structured table parsing in LaTeX two-column format.

documents.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers (Devlin et al., 2018) — arXiv:1810.04805
documents.goal: Extract a two-column NLP paper with GLUE benchmark result tables, pre-training task description, and ablation study tables. Tests extraction of numeric performance tables in academic two-column layout where numbers are dense and column alignment is critical.

documents.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (Brown et al., 2020) — arXiv:2005.14165
documents.goal: Extract a two-column paper with extensive few-shot benchmark result tables, training compute scaling tables, and model performance comparisons. This is one of the longest arXiv ML papers (70+ pages). Tests handling of very long two-column academic documents with dense result tables.

documents.title: NIST FIPS 197 — Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
documents.goal: Extract a technical cryptography standard with pseudocode listings, state matrix representations, and mathematical notation. Tests extraction of algorithmic structure, tables of hex values (16x16 SubBytes S-Box lookup), and formal specification text.
